correctness.rationale: Supported triple products give exact phase homomorphism equations; positive and negative recursions plus one bridge force a single signed phase ramp. A wrapped triple exists iff \(2r+s\ge n\), enforcing \(t^n=1\), while no wrap exists below it. Dimension bounds give packet optimality. Integer Smith form cross-check: 1,522 parameter triples and 310,585 permitted triples, exact rank and torsion confirmed. The proof covers all admitted n and does not mistake finite tests for proof.

value.rationale: Determines a complete natural Fourier-invariant fiber, a sharp critical inequality \(2r+s\ge n\), and the minimum number of bispectral phase samples for every complex unequal-band signal with fixed power. At \(n=11\) the two 6-mode supports (4,2) and (5,1) lie on opposite sides, showing the spectral imbalance is a genuine controlling invariant not just total bandwidth; the result gives a checkable optimal sampling benchmark.
